definition: The performative display of Spire-tier wealth and connectivity — conspicuous BCI overlays, ostentatious Diaspora presence, curated synthetic companions — used as social signaling. Implies shallowness; the gilt covers nothing of substance.
origin: Tier 2-3 cultural commentary, a sardonic inversion of the street term 'bright noise'; spread through Old Harbor arts communities
usage: Mid-tier residents mocking Spire culture; also used self-deprecatingly by downwardly mobile Tier 4s
example: The whole event was just gilt noise — a hundred people running the same Tessera social overlay, nobody actually talking, everyone performing.
